summary.text: Kristian Grant is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 82 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner, she previously served on the Grand Rapids Public Schools board.

paragraphs.text: Grant earned a bachelor's degree in social relations and policy from Michigan State University.
Her career experience includes owning Sydney's Boutique, Mini Mogul Academy and the 12 Oakes Business & Innovation Center.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Grant said she was born and raised on the southeast side of Grand Rapids, had served six years as a trustee of the Grand Rapids Public Schools Board of Education, including as board chair during the pandemic, and also worked in real estate development.
Grant's prior office is listed as an at-large seat on the Grand Rapids Public Schools board.
In 2025-2026 she is minority vice chair of the Economic Competitiveness Committee and serves on the Regulatory Reform and Transportation committees.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Ryan Malinoski in the general election on November 3, 2026.
In the 2022 survey, Grant named investing in children, affordable housing, reducing gun violence, protecting the environment and economic development in southeast Grand Rapids as priorities.
